verdict.rationale: Datalab has no documented region selection for its hosted API. Customers can control data residency only by running the models on infrastructure they control, which requires an Enterprise contract. That self-hosted option is aimed at data-privacy and regulated teams, is offered air-gapped, and ships with a Kubernetes Helm chart. missing for 10: region/residency choice for the hosted cloud service, residency options below the Enterprise tier, documentation of where hosted data is stored, independent corroboration.
